mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 units, coupled with rising GDP (GDPC1), indicates strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or correlation between HOUST and GDPC1 drops below 0.4 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% indicates a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to potential inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE correlation with CPIAUCSL drops below 0.3 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105, combined with rising RSAFS, signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or correlation between INDPRO and RSAFS drops below 0.35 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150,000 indicates strong demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in strong employment periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase above 1.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or FEDFUNDS correlation with GDPC1 growth rate drops below 0.2 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5%, combined with a drop in payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 100,000, indicates a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or correlation between UNRATE and PAYEMS drops below 0.4 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in CPIAUCSL above 285 indicates rising inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high-inflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
